_comment: World bible section 13. Seven Reaches on the small map, one for each Sea (the Far Sea's ice and its whaling chain are one Reach, Rime), so a Sea and its archipelago are the same thing at this size. Sugar, Whalers' and Mirage are held back for the larger maps alongside Scrap — each shared a Sea with a Reach that survives, and each sat on a painted cluster too crowded or too sparse to chart clearly. Island counts are set by how many clearly separated islands each painted cluster holds. Each Reach has a role in the opening (docs/opening.md): home is the Crown's, contested Reaches open with two islands a side, open Reaches are charted and nobody's, frontier Reaches start unexplored and hide the Confederacy's base. An island marked port is one of the three port cities on Sovereign Reach's great island.

islands.name: Ballmoor
islands.note: Foundries. The Crown's arms come from here.

islands.name: Chandler's Rest
islands.note: Hale's birthplace; quietly Confederacy-leaning.

islands.name: Highwater
islands.note: Seawalls three hundred feet high, carved with the name of every island the Tide has taken.

islands.name: Gorley
islands.note: Site of an old massacre. Hates the Crown.

islands.name: Yarrow Minor
islands.note: The royal dockyard.

islands.name: Caridad
islands.note: The Imperium's naval academy.

islands.name: Raltiera
islands.note: Banking houses. Half the war is paid for here.

islands.name: Obroa Scala
islands.note: The Great Library: charts and archives.

islands.name: Bimisario
islands.note: Market island.

islands.name: Wrightsport
islands.note: Shipwright capital of the Seven Seas; Reyne's home port.

islands.name: Duroso
islands.note: Old seafaring people. The best navigators alive.

islands.name: Gibbet Rock
islands.note: An Imperium prison. The name is not a metaphor.

islands.name: Gardenholm
islands.note: Sacred and green. No tree on it has ever been cut.

islands.name: The Kettles
islands.note: Prison mines, cutting ambergris out of a dead leviathan's skull.

islands.name: Jomarrow
islands.note: Hermit island.

islands.name: Northreach
islands.note: Torvik's homeland. Urskin whalers and harpooners.

islands.name: Tallow Cay
islands.note: Whale-oil and salt. Far enough out that nobody counts the ships.

islands.name: Tjerfon
islands.note: A cutter base, of sorts.

islands.name: Rime Island
islands.note: Frozen rock. Nothing here but weather.

islands.name: Varrow
islands.note: Fairweather's floating market: a city of lashed-together hulks.

islands.name: Greenholm
islands.note: Forested and heavily patrolled. Something large is being finished here.

islands.name: Firewatch
islands.note: An active volcano. The ash never quite settles.

islands.name: Vejun Keep
islands.note: Admiral Blackwater's private fortress. The water below it is always flat.

islands.name: Tundvik
islands.note: The edge of the charts.

islands.name: Powder Isle
islands.note: Saltpetre. Every gun in the Seven Seas owes this rock.

islands.name: Rylo Salt
islands.note: A salt-slave island. One side never sees dusk.

islands.name: Blackreef
islands.note: Jubal the Fat's corsair haven. Debts are collected here.

islands.name: The Terraces
islands.note: Rice breadbasket of the Outer Seas.

islands.name: Coralhome
islands.note: The Reef-folk. Their ships are sung into shape over years.

islands.name: Bothaway
islands.note: Home of the Rumor Guild, who sell to both sides.

islands.name: Sluysvaan
islands.note: The great civilian dockyards.

islands.name: Umgulla
islands.note: Gambling and racing. Everyone owes someone here.

islands.name: Preston's Reach
islands.note: Signal towers. Word travels fast from here.
